Note:
1. An emergency time may be allocated at the beginning of each meeting depending on the seriousness of the subject matter.
2. Even if not included in the agenda, any urgent matter (presentation of new bills, presentation of committee reports on bills, discussion on proposals, etc.) can be included in or removed from the agenda if it is deemed necessary to discuss/consider.
3. If a Member of Parliament requests time for a statement of public importance from the Hon'ble Minister, it can be granted at the beginning of the meeting, and if time is requested for a response during Zero/Special/Emergency Time, it can be granted after Zero Hour.
4. Time will be made available upon request to the Leader of the Opposition, former Prime Minister, former Speaker, etc., in accordance with parliamentary practice.
5. Days when the House does not meet are allocated for committee meetings and other purposes. Committee meetings can also be held before or after the House meeting on days when the House meets.
6. Articles 24, 27, and 30 of the Regulations, as well as other matters, may be included in the agenda as needed.

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The meeting begins with Zero Hour, Zero/Special and Emergency Time, followed by ministerial responses to questions raised. A proposal is presented to send the Act to Amend and Repeal Some Nepal Laws Related to Economy, 2083 to a committee for clause-wise discussion.

bills_discussed.name: Act to Amend and Repeal Some Nepal Laws Related to Economy, 2083

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The agenda includes Ministry-wise Question and Answer sessions, presentation of Annual Reports, and discussions on various proposals. Specific bills like the Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Act, 2083 and Passport (First Amendment) Act, 2083 are scheduled for discussion.

bills_discussed.name: Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Act, 2083

sections.name: Committee Report Presentation
sections.summary_en: A committee report concerning the revival of provisions in the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042, and related bills including the Constitutional Bodies' Officials' Remuneration, Service Conditions and Facilities (First Amendment) Act, 2083, Mines and Minerals Act, 2083, Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Act, 2083, and Passport (First Amendment) Act, 2083 are presented.

bills_discussed.name: Nepal Special Service Act, 2042 (Revival of Previous Provisions)
Constitutional Bodies' Officials' Remuneration, Service Conditions and Facilities (First Amendment) Act, 2083
Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Act, 2083

reports_presented: Committee Report on Nepal Special Service Act, 2042

sections.name: Bill Discussion and Passage
sections.summary_en: A proposal is presented to discuss and pass the Act to Revive the Previous Provisions of the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042, along with its committee report. Other legislative matters are also on the agenda.

bills_discussed.name: Nepal Special Service Act, 2042 (Revival of Previous Provisions)

reports_presented: Committee Report on Nepal Special Service Act, 2042

sections.name: Bill Discussion
sections.summary_en: A proposal is presented to discuss the Mines and Minerals Act, 2083. This is part of the ongoing legislative agenda.

sections.name: Legislative Agenda
sections.summary_en: The agenda includes Zero Hour, Special Time, Ministry-wise Question and Answer, and Presentation of Annual Reports. Various proposals are listed, including urgent, short notice, and attention-grabbing matters.

sections.name: Second Fortnight Agenda (Bhadra)
sections.summary_en: The second fortnight's agenda includes Zero Hour, Special Time, and ministerial responses. Key legislative items include discussions on the Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Act, 2083, and the Passport (First Amendment) Act, 2083.

bills_discussed.name: Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Act, 2083

sections.name: Second Fortnight Main Business
sections.summary_en: Discussions are scheduled for the Mediation (Second Amendment) Act, 2083, and the presentation of an agreement on marine biodiversity. Ministry-wise Q&A and annual reports are also on the agenda.

sections.name: Second Fortnight Legislative Agenda
sections.summary_en: The agenda includes discussions on the Child Labor (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 2083, and the Employees Provident Fund (Tenth Amendment) Act, 2083. An agreement on long-term electricity trade between Nepal and India is also to be presented.

sections.name: Second Fortnight Committee Referrals
sections.summary_en: Proposals are presented to send several bills to their respective committees, including the Constitutional Bodies' Officials' Remuneration, Service Conditions and Facilities (First Amendment) Act, 2083, Mines and Minerals Act, 2083, Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Act, 2083, and Passport (First Amendment) Act, 2083.

bills_discussed.name: Constitutional Bodies' Officials' Remuneration, Service Conditions and Facilities (First Amendment) Act, 2083
Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Act, 2083

sections.name: Second Fortnight Further Discussions
sections.summary_en: Discussions are scheduled for the Mediation (Second Amendment) Act, 2083, Child Labor (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 2083, and Employees Provident Fund (Tenth Amendment) Act, 2083. A general discussion on the Agreement on the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biological Diversity is also planned.

sections.name: Second Fortnight General Business
sections.summary_en: The agenda includes Zero Hour, Special Time, Ministry-wise Question and Answer, and Presentation of Annual Reports, followed by various proposals including urgent, short notice, and attention-grabbing matters.
